children: Michael Saylor said on X that the proposal covers STRF, STRC, STRK, and STRD, with dividends accruing each calendar day, including weekends and holidays, and paid on the next business day. According to Odaily, the related economic terms remain unchanged. The proposal is intended to support price stability, liquidity, and demand.

title: Michael Saylor Says Proposal Covers STRF, STRC, STRK, and STRD Dividends
